text:
olga: Quick alert: us-south had a burst of tiny pods (0.125 GPU) all landing on same node group then immediate evicts. Looks like new packing heuristic favored nvlink-locality too aggressively.
sam: Saw that. Scheduler log: 
```
I0605 09:12:01 scheduler.go:210] scoring pod tiny-train-3 on node gnode-11: locality=0.95 pack_penalty=0.05 final=1.00
I0605 09:12:02 attach-controller.go:52] attach failed: insufficient allocatable gpus on gnode-11
```
kai: Root cause: NVLink affinity weight applied cluster-wide by bootstrap override, meant only for multi-gang jobs. Quick mitigation: set scheduler.alpha/locality-weight=0.2 for training ns in us-south and label other warmpool nodes with `gpu.redwood/accept-tiny=true`.
olga: Ops, can you apply the labels?
infra-bot: runbook invoked: ops/label-warmpool-tiny -> us-south applied to 6 nodes
sam: I'll open PR to gate NVLink weighting behind `pod_size_threshold` and add fragmentation penalty so concentration is penalized.
kai: Also add a telemetry alert on `scheduler.fragmentation_penalty` > 0.4.
olga: Thanks, keep me posted. :thumbsup:
